overview: Practice Makes Perfect is a role-based music studio management platform for Studios, Teachers, Students, and Parents, supporting multi-studio teacher affiliations and per-enrollment studio assignments.
features: Multi-studio teacher affiliations — a teacher can be linked to multiple studios simultaneously
Per-enrollment studio assignment — each student enrollment is tied to a specific studio or marked Independent
Studio-scoped student visibility — studios only see students affiliated with them through teacher enrollments
Teacher onboarding flow — teachers create student profiles and enrollments directly from their dashboard
Role-based dashboards for Studio, Teacher, Student, and Parent
FACT table management for all lookup fields (instruments, skill levels, voice types, states, etc.)
Admin Portal with full backup/export and restore
Data Analytics portal with system-wide filtering
CSV import/export for all data tables
